codes.bad_output: The output does not match the output schema, so change the code to return the declared shape.
codes.build_failed: The server build failed, so the live version stays and you can fix the code and build again.
codes.code_off: You have no code right, so ask an admin to turn code on for your group.
codes.code_paused: An admin stopped code for your organization, so ask an admin to turn it on again.
codes.compile_failed: The screen did not compile, so open the console and fix the file and line it names.
codes.contract_unsupported: The server does not serve the contract version that the folder pins, so pin a served version.
codes.door_refused: The door refused the call, so read its reason and change the call to fit.
codes.limit_exceeded: The version or the call went past a limit, so make the source smaller or the call lighter.
codes.not_approved: A publisher has not approved this version yet, so ask a publisher to approve it.
codes.runtime_busy: Try again in a few seconds.
codes.timeout: The call ran too long, so make it do less work and run it again.
